breathe.title: Breathe
breathe.aboutBody: Paced breathing with a circle and haptic cues: one light pulse as you breathe in, two as you breathe out, none on a hold. With your band live, Pulse shows your heart rate; when the band also sends beat-to-beat intervals, it takes a one-minute HRV reading (RMSSD) before and after. Sessions stay on this phone and scores don’t use them.
breathe.hapticHint: One pulse to breathe in, two to breathe out
breathe.recentEmpty: Your sessions appear here, with heart rate and HRV when the band was live.
breathe.noBandRunning: No band connected: this session is pacing only.
breathe.noBand: Connect your band over Bluetooth to see your heart rate, and HRV before and after when the band sends beat-to-beat intervals.
breathe.noContact: No skin contact: wear the band snug.
breathe.heartRateOnly: Heart rate only: this band doesn’t send beat-to-beat intervals, so there’s no HRV reading.
breathe.needsRr: Needs beat-to-beat intervals and a still minute
breathe.swingNote: How far your heart rate rose and fell with each breath
breathe.cardBody: A few minutes of slow, paced breathing to settle. With your band live, see your heart rate fall and your HRV before and after.
